title: Gmail Mail Flow, Routing & Email Authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) & Compliance
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Get Gmail mail flow, routing, and email authentication right
problem: Mail that silently lands in spam, spoofed domains, and compliance gaps trace back to mail flow, routing, and authentication that were never designed. This solution configures Gmail's enterprise mail plane end to end: inbound/outbound routing and hosts, split/dual delivery for coexistence, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC (monitor → enforce), content-compliance and routing rules, and attachment/spam controls — so mail is deliverable, authenticated, and compliant.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Gmail mail plane: routing/hosts, split & dual delivery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, content-compliance/routing rules, and the enforcement journey.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, DNS control for the domains, coexistence source if any, compliance policy).

Implementation Guide — configure routing/hosts, set up SPF/DKIM and DMARC (p=none → quarantine → reject with report review), build content-compliance + routing rules, and tune spam/attachment controls — pilot-first, each rule named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (auth passing, DMARC aligned, rules routing correctly) plus Best Practices for safely moving DMARC to enforcement without breaking legitimate senders.
short: Design and configure the Gmail mail plane — routing/hosts, split/dual delivery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC (monitor→enforce), content-compliance and routing rules, spam/attachment controls — so mail is deliverable, authenticated, and compliant. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
